responsibility: Provides reusable utility algorithms for IPA passes, especially callgraph traversal and CFG reasoning helpers. It implements Tarjan-based SCC and reduced postorder construction, reverse postorder helpers, profile merging support, recursive-call and termination predicates, and analysis routines such as finding always-executed basic blocks. This file supplies shared graph/CFG infrastructure used by many neighboring ipa-* passes rather than owning a specific optimization.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable utility algorithms declared by ipa-utils.h, such as Tarjan-based callgraph ordering, profile merging, recursion/termination checks, and always-executed-BB discovery.
